bluesky.text:
The Engineering Mind: the capacity to zoom out to see the forest (context, systems, big picture) and then zoom in to study the trees (details, causes, impact).

It doesn't stay in theory. It pushes you to act.

https://automato.substack.com/p/develop-your-engineering-mind

I like to philosophize about AGI, but what about ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini doing that while I watch?
Someone else thought about it and made it a video:
https://youtu.be/4j72NRNsFHs

Nvidia Huang is back, one more piece of evidence that having tons of money is the true goal of life.
I don't know why I always return to my default: money is a consequence of doing things right.

Anyway... both might be wrong. In the end, I don't have enough money to be right even when I'm not.

You need domain expertise to use AI well. But AI is eliminating the work that builds domain expertise.

The people who can use AI most effectively are those who learned without it.

The learning ladder is gone.

https://automato.substack.com/p/ai-building-for-2023-or-2026

My inbox receives the newsletters I’m subscribed to in batches. Same days, same hours. Everybody follows the “best time to send” advice.
The effect: I don’t read them. It’s too much.
And most of them write about the same things, because everybody scans what’s popular right now.
